browse_api.description:
Morris Day – Color of Success
Warner Bros. Records – 1-25320
1985 U.S. Vinyl LP

Solo album from Morris Day, frontman of The Time and a major figure in the Minneapolis funk sound associated with Prince.

Features:

“Color of Success”
“The Character”
“The Oak Tree”
“Love Sign”
“Don’t Wait for Me”
“Love/Addiction”

Vinyl retains strong gloss with light visible surface marks consistent with normal handling and play. No major deep scratches are apparent in the photos. Visually graded VG+.

Original jacket shows noticeable shelf wear, edge and corner wear, surface rubbing, and creasing, including wear near the upper-right portion of the back cover. Cover graded approximately VG-.

Please review all photos carefully, as they are part of the condition description.

Label: Warner Bros. Records
Catalog #: 1-25320
Format: 12" LP, 33⅓ RPM, Stereo
Genre: Funk / R&B / Soul / Minneapolis Sound
